name: Francisco Assis - Après le § 22 - Am 39
title: REPORT on human rights and democracy in the world and the European Union’s policy on the matter – annual report 2025
part_text: 22d. Is deeply worried by the United States’ aggression and blatant violation of international law, following its abduction of the Venezuelan President and his wife Cilia Flores; calls for their immediate liberation; notes with deep concern that the United States violated the UN Charter three times in this incident, with military aggression against a country, the abduction of a sitting head of state and the bombing of civilians;
